Run MAST differential expression

Source: R/tool-mast.R
runMAST.Rd

Runs MAST (Finak et al. 2015) to find marker features between clusters of a giotto object and returns its per-feature tests (see mastParam() for the columns). The giotto object is not changed.

  • With group_1 and group_2, one comparison: the cells of the group_1 clusters against those of the group_2 clusters. All features are returned.

  • Without them, each cluster against all other clusters (those in subset_clusters, or all). Per cluster, the min_feats best features are kept and any other with fdr < pval and coef > logFC; the ranking column gives the rank within the cluster.

MAST fits a model per feature on a dense matrix, so it is slow on large data. If you use it, please cite the original paper (see mastParam()).

Usage

runMAST(
  gobject,
  cluster_column,
  spat_unit = NULL,
  feat_type = NULL,
  expression_values = "normalized",
  group_1 = NULL,
  group_2 = NULL,
  group_1_name = NULL,
  group_2_name = NULL,
  subset_clusters = NULL,
  adjust_columns = NULL,
  pval = 0.001,
  logFC = 1,
  min_feats = 10L,
  param = NULL,
  verbose = NULL
)

Arguments

gobject

giotto object

cluster_column

cell metadata column with the clusters

spat_unit, feat_type

spatial unit and feature type

expression_values

expression values to use (MAST expects log-scale values)

group_1, group_2

clusters of the two sides of a single comparison

group_1_name, group_2_name

names of the two sides (default: the cluster IDs joined by _)

subset_clusters

clusters compared one against the others (default: all)

adjust_columns

cell metadata columns to adjust for (e.g. the detection rate)

pval, logFC, min_feats

filters of the one-against-the-others results

param

a mastParam(); its defaults when NULL

verbose

be verbose

Value

A data.table of MAST's results.

References

Finak G, McDavid A, Yajima M, Deng J, Gersuk V, Shalek AK, Slichter CK, Miller HW, McElrath MJ, Prlic M, Linsley PS, Gottardo R. MAST: a flexible statistical framework for assessing transcriptional changes and characterizing heterogeneity in single-cell RNA sequencing data. Genome Biology 16, 278 (2015). doi:10.1186/s13059-015-0844-5

See also

mastParam()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")
# cluster 1 against clusters 2 and 3
runMAST(g, cluster_column = "leiden_clus", group_1 = 1, group_2 = c(2, 3))
# every cluster against the others
runMAST(g, cluster_column = "leiden_clus")
} # }
